stock.description: Telecom Digital Holdings Limited is an investment holding company that operates extensively within the telecommunications sector and its ancillary businesses, with a presence across Hong Kong and mainland China. The company's diverse operations are structured into key segments: Retail Business, Distribution Business, Operation Services, and other endeavors. Its Retail Business arm is dedicated to marketing mobile devices and a variety of consumer goods, alongside offering related support services. The Distribution Business focuses on the wholesale supply of mobile phones and providing associated services. Meanwhile, the Operation Services segment delivers various operational solutions. Beyond these core activities, the company also undertakes the installation, maintenance, and management of paging transmission stations, provides essential technical support services, offers paging and a range of other telecommunication services, and furnishes management consultancy and expert professional services. Additionally, Telecom Digital Holdings engages in e-commerce ventures and makes property investments. By March 31, 2022, the company had established a significant retail footprint, overseeing 82 stores. Founded in 1974, the firm's headquarters are situated in Kowloon Bay, Hong Kong, and it operates as a subsidiary of CKK Investment Limited.
